clue.text: Giving no answer

parts.note: read as declining a request, saying no when asked, rather than staying silent

explanation.definitionFit: Turning down a request means declining it, which is literally giving the reply no.

clue.text: Music that produces initially just a snoring sound

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of the word just

parts.note: ZZ is the comic-strip sound of someone snoring

explanation.surface: A sleepy tune whose only effect on listeners is to set them snoring.
explanation.definitionFit: A genre of music born in New Orleans, built on swing and improvisation.

clue.text: Way to go round promenade?

parts.note: a leisurely walk is the natural way of getting along a seaside walkway

explanation.definitionFit: A gentle unhurried walk, exactly how one covers a seafront parade.

clue.text: Behave unnaturally before nurse

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
to tend someone is to nurse them

explanation.surface: Someone acting oddly in front of a hospital nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: To make believe or put on a false act is to behave in a way that is not natural.

clue.text: Traveller's manner gets lighter in conversation

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the definition reads as Traveller

parts.note: a way of doing something is a manner

indicators.note: in conversation means as spoken, so the word for lighter counts by its sound

parts.note: fairer means lighter in colour, as of skin or hair

explanation.surface: A traveller's demeanour becomes more cheerful when chatting.
explanation.definitionFit: A wayfarer is a traveller on foot, someone journeying along the road.

clue.text: Nasty chore, standing in queue after arranging method of payment

indicators.note: standing in places one set of letters inside the other, like a person standing in a line
after arranging tells us the word queue is first rearranged
nasty suggests the word chore is spoiled into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: An unpleasant task: waiting in line to sort out how to pay.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's grim wait in line hides two separate rearrangements: 'Nasty' works on chore, 'after arranging' on queue, and 'standing in' nests the first result within the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheque once usable across Europe, drawn on a home bank to pay abroad.

clue.text: When warmed up, one should sing

definitions.text: When warmed up, one should sing

parts.words: When warmed up, one should sing
parts.note: read as a vessel on the stove that whistles or hums as water heats, not a singer warming up

explanation.definitionFit: A pot for boiling water that famously sings as it nears the boil.

clue.text: Cannot, in rush, put back container

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside the other
put back means the word for rush is turned round

parts.note: a rush is a reed-like waterside plant
cannot contracts to can't

explanation.surface: Someone unable, in their haste, to return a container to its place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns the plant into DEER, and 'in' sets the contracted cannot inside it; 'rush' looks like haste but is the waterside plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoppered glass vessel for serving wine or spirits.

clue.text: A maiden accustomed to be tickled

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
used to something means accustomed to it

explanation.surface: A young woman who is used to being tickled.
explanation.definitionFit: Being tickled in the figurative sense means being entertained or made to laugh.

clue.text: Before final letter, make a charge against shipping route

indicators.note: Before places the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: to sue is to bring a legal claim against someone
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Accusing someone of something just ahead of a closing letter of a message.
explanation.walkthrough: SUEZ is the Egyptian canal linking the Mediterranean and Red Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The canal through Egypt is one of the world's busiest shipping lanes.

clue.text: Lacking variety when under the weather

definitions.meaning: read literally as having run out of kinds or types
an idiom for feeling slightly unwell or grumpy

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for feeling unwell or irritable, also read literally as without sorts.

clue.text: Accompanying a learner driver, moreover

parts.note: with means accompanying, in company of
L is the learner plate on a British learner driver's car

explanation.surface: Sitting beside a novice motorist, as a further point.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned adverb meaning besides or in addition.

clue.text: One who gives the thumbs-up sign by the way

definitions.text: One who gives the thumbs-up sign by the way

parts.words: One who gives the thumbs-up sign by the way
parts.note: read as a roadside traveller raising a thumb to cadge a lift, not an approver

explanation.definitionFit: A person travelling by thumbing lifts from passing drivers at the roadside.

clue.text: Gas main?

parts.note: the main is poetic for the sea, so a gas sea is the offshore field supplying Britain's gas

explanation.walkthrough: Britain's natural gas comes largely from fields under the sea off its east coast.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea between Britain and Scandinavia, famous for its offshore gas fields.

clue.text: Excited when dealing with notes

parts.note: musical notes, so this is the Italian direction for playing in an agitated way

explanation.definitionFit: An Italian musical marking telling performers to play restlessly and hurriedly.

clue.text: Persistence needs certainty — possibly not right

indicators.note: possibly signals the remaining letters can be arranged in another way
not tells us the letter for right is left out

explanation.surface: Keeping going requires being sure, though perhaps being wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes R from CERTAINTY, leaving CETAINTY; 'possibly' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Determination to keep hold of a purpose is a synonym of persistence.

clue.text: Credit given with dodgy quote — it's a competitive game

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

indicators.note: dodgy suggests the word quote is unreliable and shaken up

explanation.surface: Someone credited with a dubious quotation, played as a rivalry.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawn game played by knocking balls through hoops with mallets.

clue.text: Inevitable without it becoming sought-after

indicators.note: becoming signals the remaining letters change into a new form
without means the word it is removed from what precedes

explanation.surface: Something unavoidable turning into something desirable once a certain thing is removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes I and T from INEVITABLE, leaving NEVIABLE; 'becoming' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something desirable enough that others envy you having it.

clue.text: Medium's car?

definitions.meaning: a ... can be a means or channel of expression

explanation.definitionFit: A word for both a means of conveying ideas and a motor transport.

clue.text: Trade in former money

parts.note: ex- means former
change is money in coins

explanation.definitionFit: To exchange is to trade one thing for another.

clue.text: Ruler in double-cross, partly taken in by crooked seer

parts.note: a cross is the letter X, and double gives two of them

indicators.note: taken in by places a letter inside the rearranged word
crooked suggests the word seer is bent out of shape

parts.note: the second X from the double cross

explanation.surface: A monarch duped by a dishonest fortune-teller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' says only one X goes in: 'crooked' makes ERES of SEER, the second X sits inside, the first leads.
explanation.definitionFit: Xerxes was a king of ancient Persia.

clue.text: Provide space for books put aside

definitions.meaning: to postpone or drop a plan

explanation.definitionFit: Both fitting with shelves and postponing a plan indefinitely.

clue.text: I would make notes about short track

indicators.note: about puts one piece around the other

parts.note: to sing is to make musical notes
I would contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone deciding to jot down notes on a brief song.
explanation.definitionFit: A short stretch of rail beside the main line for shunting trains.

clue.text: Bright idea to hit kid on the head?

parts.note: to brain someone is to hit them on the head; the words on the head complete that sense
a kid is a child

explanation.surface: A clever plan for knocking a child on the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the head?' finishes 'hit' as the sense of brain.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainchild is an original idea or invention someone has thought up.

clue.text: Evident one is not included in project

indicators.note: is not included means the letter for one is dropped

parts.note: plain means obvious or evident
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Something obvious left out of a project.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to project is to plan or schedule.

clue.text: Advertisement's turned up very loud

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the definition reads as Advertisement

indicators.note: turned means the word up is read backwards

parts.note: FF is fortissimo, very loud in music

explanation.surface: An advert's volume cranked up high.
explanation.definitionFit: A puff is a piece of exaggerated promotional praise.

clue.text: Show remorse being locked up for at least the second time

parts.words: for at least the second time
parts.note: re- means again, at least a second time
pent means shut in, as in pent up

explanation.surface: A prisoner feeling contrition on a repeat stretch inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel regret and resolve to do better for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Avalanche that's seen at end of voyage?

definitions.meaning: read as a fall of land, a landslip
a sailor's first sight of land after a sea journey

explanation.definitionFit: Both a collapse of ground and the first sighting of land from a ship.
